title: Freedom of Information Act – FOIA (Luật Tự do Thông tin)

versions.text:
Freedom of Information Act (FOIA) – 5 USC §552.
Right of public access to federal agency records. Nine exemptions: (1) classified national defense, (2) internal personnel rules, (3) statutory exemptions, (4) trade secrets, (5) inter-agency memoranda, (6) personal privacy, (7) law enforcement records, (8) financial institution regulation, (9) geological information.
